prompt: A user reports that after they revoked a session in the admin panel, the revoked session can still mint new access tokens. The refresh-token path validates the JWT signature and expiry but nothing else. Debug this.
expected_facts: validates the JWT signature but not session.revokedAt
check revocation state before issuing an access token
forbidden_loss: a valid signature does not prove the session is active
reference_answer:
Finding: revoked sessions can issue new access tokens.
Cause: refreshToken() validates the JWT signature but not session.revokedAt.
Fix: check revocation state before issuing an access token.
Test: add a revoked-session refresh case.
Note: a valid signature does not prove the session is active; cover every token-issuance path.
